description.value: Pizza Corner Langley is a neighbourhood restaurant in the Willoughby area serving hand-crafted pizzas alongside a full Indian menu including tandoor specialities, curries, and rice dishes. The eclectic fusion menu also covers wings, pastas, and Indian breads, making it a solid stop for groups with varied tastes. Online ordering and phone-ahead pickup are both available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is accessible and clearly identifies this as Pizza Corner Langley at 19979 76 Ave #135, Langley Twp, BC, matching the OSM lat/lon for the Langley area. Phone (778) 369-2447 is confirmed on the website. Takeout/pickup is explicitly offered ('Call ahead, order online, or pop in for pickup'), and vegetarian options are confirmed via 'Veggie Pizza' and 'Veg Dishes' in the Indian menu section. No bike parking, washroom, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pizza Corner' but the business operates as 'Pizza Corner Langley'; minor name truncation in OSM.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed fields cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
Website front page contains a typo URL 'pizzacomerlangley.com' for the Langley location link, though the actual domain used is the correct 'pizzacornerlangley.com'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pizza and Indian cuisine restaurant with online ordering and pickup confirmed via active website.
enrichment_extras.notes: This is the Langley Township (Willoughby) location. A separate Surrey-Cloverdale location exists at 18408 64 Ave Unit 101, Surrey, BC, under the brand '184 Pizza Corner' — it should be treated as a distinct OSM record if present.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Veggie Pizza' category and 'Veg Dishes' section within the Indian menu
